plain_sentence: the same, at the three-listener bar
population_rule_exposure: LBA-X6 — U's membership moves with the threshold, so a U-row threshold comparison has the population as a DEPENDENT variable and is not one-column in the sense V and P are
filter_meaning: no committed payload censused U, and unlistenable_drop.py raises PopulationNotCensused for any archive holding artists the census never evaluated — so the filter is OFF. This is ABSENT-BECAUSE-REFUSED, not inert-because-applicable, and it is §2.4's dangerous term: the arms that grow the population are exactly the arms in which the quality filter stops operating
unguarded_drop_stages_note: drop_no_release_tail and drop_featured_credit have NO census guard: over U they silently UNDER-FILTER rather than refusing
instrument_note: s4_instrument.py — a forward copy of stage 1's stage2_build_instrument.py, fixing a Thread._stop name collision that made every real build raise at teardown. The fit rule, the 24 GB bar and the row reader are IMPORTED from the stage-1 module unchanged.

builder_log: rescale p99 scale=1287 | saturated edges 286966 of 28677516 (1.001%)

additive_keys_note: require_fame=False removes FAME ONLY. deezer_ids and the three LUX-4 keys come from frozen sha-pinned package data, not a fetch, so this census build carries four of the five additive keys. LBA-M1's bytes are computed BARE by decoding, so they are unaffected; the boot-memory half is measured on a bare copy for the same reason, so that metadata_ratio is not applied to an artifact that already carries the metadata it models.

notes.node_count: gross-loss tripwire only: the prune's effect over U is unmeasured (§2.4), so no calibrated floor exists and a tight one would refuse a correct build
notes.edge_count: gross-loss tripwire only: CSR entries >= N after the prune, since U's minimum-degree floor is 1. It cannot see a cap-rule revert on a U arm; the upper bound and the median-degree bound do
notes.famous_detectors: unscaled at every population rule: acceptance.py group 1 describes a defect's SHAPE, not a population's size
notes.basis: population 456,469 (rule U, known before the build); served map 58,838 nodes / 1,315,684 CSR entries; degree ceiling 50

units: csr_entries and every sidecar's 'edges' = each connection in BOTH directions; connections_degree_sum_over_2 = counted once; archive.neighbour_rows = pre-cap, two per pair. Three different units — never compared across.
